summary: The architecture and checking rules are well specified, but the ADR is not implementable as written until it names the concrete scalar adapters (library types, Dhall/wire encodings, ranges) beyond Probability and the lowering rule for positional constructors and newtypes.

questions.text: Which library types back each non-Probability scalar kind (Integer/Natural incl. bounded Int, decimal, date, instant, money, String), with what canonical Dhall and wire encodings and range limits?
questions.reason: Drives the recognizer table, persisted codecs and identity encoding; the ADR requires reviewed adapters selecting type, parameters, encoding and checks together but specifies only Probability (basis points).

questions.text: How do non-empty positional constructors and union arms with several fields or record syntax lower into Shape: synthesized names, anonymous record payloads, or rejection?
questions.reason: Record needs FieldNames and a union arm has one Maybe Shape, so this fixes persisted shapes, codecs and FieldRole addressing; the ADR covers only the zero-field case and excludes multi-element tuples.

questions.text: Are newtypes transparent in Shape and on the wire, and can a newtype over Text or a date satisfy Title or Timeline?
questions.reason: Changes lowering, codecs, affordance checks and identity input; the ADR says identifiers are ordinary newtypes and roles accept types 'optionally wrapped' without saying whether that includes newtypes.

questions.text: What Haskell type must a reference field have, and can CollectionDecl address references nested in records, optionals, lists or union payloads?
questions.reason: Determines the annotation pass, reference checking and projected shapes; the ADR gives flat reference-field/target pairs and says checking verifies 'an ID's representation' without naming it.

questions.text: Where are type, field and constructor descriptions and examples authored, and do they enter SchemaMetadata, the ContractId and the projections?
questions.reason: Identity hashes 'all metadata, including descriptions', so the source decides what invalidates bindings; the ADR says to colocate descriptions but SchemaMetadata only has RoleDecl descriptions.

questions.text: In a persistent root, is a [Fact a] that is not a direct root field (nested record, Maybe, inside a payload) rejected, treated as plain data, or a nested collection?
questions.reason: Affects root checking and storage routing; checkRootLayout only covers direct [Fact a] fields while Verification mentions 'nested collections'.

questions.text: Is a metadata export that throws or diverges during evaluation a Diagnostic or a Failure, and is evaluation bounded by a time or resource limit?
questions.reason: Sets exception translation and GuestExecution limits; the ADR classifies ill-typed source as diagnostics and infrastructure as CompilerUnavailable but not runtime failure of authored metadata.

questions.text: Which encoding does projectJsonSchema describe for codec-specific scalars: guest wire/persistence ("8500") or model contract (0.85), or both via a mode?
questions.reason: Discovery clients and validators break on the wrong encoding; the ADR defines both Probability encodings and a single CheckedContract -> JsonSchema signature.

questions.text: What does projectJsonSchema emit beyond structure: dialect, roles, collection/reference annotations, descriptions, ContractId?
questions.reason: Decides whether presentation clients read roles from JSON Schema or a separate surface; the ADR only says InspectedSchema.contract is the common source and JsonSchema is a discovery projection.

questions.text: Are duplicate RoleDecl names, declared-but-unused roles, one role used across several record types, and duplicate collection names or root fields rejected, and what name characters are allowed?
questions.reason: Each is a diagnostic or silent acceptance; the ADR rejects duplicate field/case names and each role once per record, not declaration-level duplicates.

questions.text: Besides declared collection fields, what else may a persistent root record contain, and may two collections share a payload type?
questions.reason: Non-collection root fields would need storage; the ADR only requires a single record constructor with every direct [Fact a] declared.

questions.text: Are nested optionals (Maybe (Maybe a)) and optionals inside lists supported, and how is inner Nothing distinguished in JSON?
questions.reason: JSON null cannot distinguish the layers, so this fixes the persisted/wire shape; the ADR only separates nullary union arms from optionals.

questions.text: Does a FieldRole or CollectionDecl naming an existing but unreachable record type fail validation or get ignored?
questions.reason: Matters for metadata modules shared by roots and queries; the ADR rejects 'missing types' and says roles refer to reachable records, without defining missing as unreachable.
